visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and glasses stands outdoors under a metal canopy, speaking enthusiastically to the camera. He wears a black t-shirt, black cargo pants, and a red bracelet. Behind him is a busy street and parked cars. (2) The scene shifts to reveal a white vintage-style sedan. The man is joined by another man in a black polo shirt with a company logo. They stand in front of the vehicle, gesturing toward its clean white exterior and chrome accents. (3) Close-up shots display the car's restoration details: the wheels are shown in 'before and after' states, and the interior features new cream-colored quilted leather seats. (4) The men open the car's hood to inspect the engine. The engine bay appears exceptionally clean and well-maintained. The man with glasses points to various parts while the other man explains. (5) A close-up of the rear of the car shows a winged chrome logo and the license plate '4711-KM'. (6) The two men stand together in the parking lot, looking directly at the camera and speaking with high energy, concluding the presentation with friendly gestures.
